description: Read the benefits the companies behind one or more token instruments offer in one market, each with what a holder must do to reach it, how it is delivered, and whether it is an illustrative example. Give one or more instrument ids and the two-letter country.

country.description: The market whose stored policy shapes the answer: its two-letter country code, such as PT.

instruments.description: The instruments to read: one or more, at most 200 in one read, each an ISIN such as US0000000009 or a CAIP-19 instrument id such as eip155:88880/erc20:0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000.

name: get_benefit_availability

benefits.description: The benefits the count counts, present on a full row and absent on a badge_only row.

fulfilment.description: How the benefit reaches the holder: CODE for a discount code or voucher, POINTS_CREDIT for points, VENUE_REDEMPTION for access at the venue, CHAIN_MINT for a digital collectible, TOKEN_TRANSFER for a token sent to the holder's wallet, and REWARD_FULFILMENT for a merchant reward ordered with a fulfilment provider.

funder.description: Who funds the offer: Yutai, its issuer, a distributor or a brand.

illustrative.description: True when the benefit is an example Yutai made up, not an offer a real company has agreed to.

name.description: The benefit's name as the company writes it.

plus.description: The Yutai Plus facts, present only on a distributor-scoped offer the calling key's own distributor may see; absent on every base offer and on every other distributor's answer.

distributorName.description: The distributor's own name from Yutai's member record, the name the Plus offer stands under.

progress.description: The wallet's streak toward the tier that asks days; present only on an eligibility answer and only when that tier asks days.

requiredDays.description: The whole days the tier asks for.

streakDays.description: Whole days the wallet has held the security, the one clock the tier reads.

rewardTiers.description: The programme's reward tiers in ladder order, each with the one short requirement sentence.

name.description: The tier's name as the programme carries it.

requirement.description: The one short sentence the tier's holding and days read as.
What the holder must do to reach the benefit, in the company's own short words.

scope.description: Who the offer is shown to: base for every distributor, distributor for the distributors it names.

count.description: How many benefits the company offers in the caller's country.

display.description: full lists the benefits, badge_only carries the count alone.

illustrative.description: True when every benefit the count counts is illustrative, meaning an example Yutai made up rather than a real offer.

isin.description: The instrument's ISIN, in the registry's canonical spelling.

title: Get benefit availability
